---
title: "Quarto + Altair + Observable"
---

## 1. Altair: brushing a scatter to filter bars

```{python}
import altair as alt
from vega_datasets import data

cars = data.cars()
brush = alt.selection_interval()

points = alt.Chart(cars).mark_point().encode(
    x="Horsepower:Q",
    y="Miles_per_Gallon:Q",
    color=alt.condition(brush, "Origin:N", alt.value("lightgray")),
).add_params(brush)

bars = alt.Chart(cars).mark_bar().encode(
    y="Origin:N",
    x="count()",
    color="Origin:N",
).transform_filter(brush)

points & bars
```

## 2. Vega-Lite spec as a dict

```{python}
spec = {
    "data": {"url": "https://vega.github.io/vega-datasets/data/cars.json"},
    "mark": "bar",
    "encoding": {
        "x": {"field": "Cylinders", "type": "ordinal"},
        "y": {"aggregate": "mean", "field": "Horsepower"},
    },
}
alt.Chart.from_dict(spec)
```

## 3. Observable Plot

```{ojs}
Plot = require("@observablehq/plot")
penguins = FileAttachment("penguins.csv").csv({typed: true})
```

```{ojs}
Plot.plot({
  marks: [
    Plot.dot(penguins, {x: "bill_length_mm", y: "bill_depth_mm", fill: "species"})
  ],
  color: {legend: true}
})
```

## 4. Python to D3

```{python}
import pandas as pd

df = pd.DataFrame({"x": range(10), "y": [i**2 for i in range(10)]})
ojs_define(data=df)
```

```{ojs}
d3 = require("d3@7")
rows = transpose(data)

{
  const svg = d3.create("svg").attr("viewBox", [0, 0, 400, 200]);
  const x = d3.scaleLinear([0, 9], [30, 380]);
  const y = d3.scaleLinear([0, 81], [180, 10]);

  svg.append("path")
    .datum(rows)
    .attr("fill", "none")
    .attr("stroke", "steelblue")
    .attr("stroke-width", 2)
    .attr("d", d3.line().x(d => x(d.x)).y(d => y(d.y)));

  return svg.node();
}
```
